# People

This area groups the individuals and academic groups who govern, manage, research, and provide clinical care within the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) and the broader Danish healthcare system. It covers the interdisciplinary steering committee members—ranging from chief physicians and epidemiologists to data managers and patient representatives—who oversee methodological validity, regional benchmarking, and data protection, as well as the researchers whose validation studies establish the registry's epidemiological foundation.

## Pages

- [[entities/people/data-governance/index|Data Governance]] — Quality consultants and authority representatives ensuring regulatory compliance and registry integrity.
- [[entities/people/data-managers/index|Data Managers]] — Technical staff responsible for data processing, collection, and operational quality assurance.
- [[entities/people/epidemiologists/index|Epidemiologists]] — Scientists driving national quality measurement, standardized coding, and evidence-based guidelines.
- [[entities/people/health-leaders/index|Health Leaders]] — Chief physicians and department heads holding strategic governance roles on the steering committee.
- [[entities/people/healthcare-professionals/index|Healthcare Professionals]] — Clinical professors, consultant physicians, and nursing directors representing Denmark's five healthcare regions.
- [[entities/people/patient-representatives/index|Patient Representatives]] — Advocates integrating the patient perspective into the design of national quality indicators.
- [[entities/people/researchers/index|Researchers]] — Authors of pivotal validation studies confirming the predictive value of national registry diagnoses.
